notes: The chain עָרֵי הַגִּלְעָד → *the cities of Gilead* writes a single *the* and its rectum carries an article morpheme, so under rule 29 that article takes the written *the*, fronted to the phrase's left edge, and the construct noun stands bare. The verse had given the construct a supplied *the* and marked the article unrepresented, which is the treatment for a phrase where no *the* is written at all (JOS.13.11, JOS.13.31). This is the same construction the chapter analyses the other way at JOS.13.7, 13.14, 13.20 and 13.33, and rule 29's own toponym example (בְּנֵי הָרָמָה → *The children of Ramah*) is the ruling.
